'''Corellian Chemical Corporation''', alternatively referred to as '''Corellia Chemical Corporation''' or '''CorChemCo''', was a subsidiary company of [[Chiewab Amalgamated Pharmaceuticals Company]]. They were a producer of industrial chemicals based in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]].

==History==
During the [[Battle of Corellia]] that occurred in [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR dates|4}}</ref> the CorChemCo [[Corellia Chemical Corporation factory|factory]] located in the [[Labor Valley]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] took heavy damage and was going to explode. Fortunately, [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces were able to shut down the chemical refining equipment and avoid hundreds of civilian casualties.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Volatile Chemicals|Corellia}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the criminal [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] organization set up a remote base on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] from which they planned to steal the company's stocks of the poisonous [[chronamite]] mineral. As the company knew from past experiences that local security was heavily infiltrated with Black Sun spies, they decided to hire an independent strike team to ambush and destroy the Black Sun base, while relocating their chronamite supplies to a better guarded location.<ref name="SWG:BSSC">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Black Sun Stealing Chronamite}} on Corellia</ref>
